command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); `$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){Write-Output ('PROJECT='+`$p); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n); foreach(`$line in (`$o -split '\r?\n')){if(`$line -match '^ip route-static (150|160)|^static-lsp'){Write-Output `$line}}}}"
